overlay.description: Paths owned by this repository. Source files at these paths are replaced, never copied.

exclude.description: Source paths that are never exported (glob, matched against the full path).

patterns.docs/**: planning, internal security and decision documents
patterns.assets/**: original media sources and the external media manifest (not used by build or tests)
patterns.**/.env.*: local secrets (the committed example is re-included below)

include.description: Exceptions to the exclusions above, needed by tests or CI.

paths.docs/security/rbac-matrix.md: compared with the permission catalogue by a unit test
paths..env.example: placeholder values only; CI copies it to .env

forbidden_paths.description: Export fails closed if an included path matches one of these.

forbidden_content.description: Export fails closed if an exported file matches one of these (Python regular expressions). Personal-data patterns are added from private-rules.json.

transform.description: Pseudonymised files. The replacement table is kept outside this repository (private-rules.json on the maintainer machine); every replacement must match, otherwise the export fails.
